label: MQTT → Kafka middleware
info: Subscribes to the MQTT topics declared in the architecture document, normalises payloads to the Unified Event Schema, and publishes on the Kafka topic events.raw. Mirrors the role of middleware/app/services/ai_engine_client.to_unified_event() but for the MQTT path instead of the HTTP path.

name: normalize → UnifiedEvent
publish → Kafka events.raw
